newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Gold Bridge stock suspended.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Gold Bridge stock suspended.

text.p: Malaysia's Gold Bridge Engineering and Construction Bhd stock was suspended on Monday at the company's request, an official at the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said.
A spokesman at Gold Bridge said the company will be releasing its results for the year ended March 31, 1997 and will likely also make another corporate announcement.
No further details were available. The company is a Penang-based contractor.
Shares of Gold Bridge closed at 11.70 ringgit on Friday.
